instructions.text: Boil a pound of fine potatoes, peel them, mash them, and rub them through a cullender
Stir together to a cream, three quarters of a pound of sugar, and the same quantity of butter

Add to them gradually, a wine glass of rose water, a glass of wine, and a glass of brandy; a tea-spoonful of powdered mace and cinnamon, a grated nutmeg, and the juice and grated peel of a large lemon
Beat six eggs very light, and add them by degrees to the mixture, alternately with the potato
Bake it three quarters of an hour in a buttered dish

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil a pound of fine potatoes, peel them, mash them, and rub them through a cullender
2. Stir together to a cream, three quarters of a pound of sugar, and the same quantity of butter
3. Add to them gradually, a wine glass of rose water, a glass of wine, and a glass of brandy; a tea-spoonful of powdered mace and cinnamon, a grated nutmeg, and the juice and grated peel of a large lemon
4. Beat six eggs very light, and add them by degrees to the mixture, alternately with the potato
5. Bake it three quarters of an hour in a buttered dish
